mintAuthority.summary: TBILL is the share token of OpenEden's BVI-registered professional fund; mint/redeem is KYC-gated institutional subscription at NAV. On-chain, the Ethereum ERC1967 proxy (OpenEdenVaultV5) is owned by a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 multisig (5 signers, 4-of-5 threshold, no modules) and has no separate proxy admin.
